topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't believe this. I mean, really? All that planning, all those texts, the effort to make it a surprise, and now this? It's as if the day decided to hide, to disappear. They said the party was cancelled. Just like that. No explanations, no nothing. I suppose I’ll just sit here, surrounded by the empty space where the laughter was supposed to be, wondering what went wrong. Maybe I should have seen it coming, the way the sun hides behind the clouds right before a storm. Well, they’ve picked a fine time to pull this stunt. I guess I’ll find something else to do. Maybe stare at the wall until it starts to make more sense.
